description: Computes a DRY-RUN payroll preview for a pay period, as Preview on the Payroll page does: periodStart and periodEnd as YYYY-MM-DD. It computes each cleaner's gross from actuals plus the bonus/deduction ledger and writes dry_run payout rows; it moves NO money and submits NOTHING to Gusto (real submission is the owner's own action in the app). A locked (submitted or paid) period returns its stored lines and writes nothing. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: preview_payroll
title: Preview a payroll run
